about_the_game:
Doge Storm: Lead the Chaos as Tlon

Step into the whirlwind of Doge Storm, an electrifying strategy simulation, where you embody Tlon, a fearless reformer thrust into the heart of a nation teetering on the edge. This isn’t your average management game—it’s a rollercoaster of tough decisions, wild events, and quirky characters that test your wits and reshape a world in flux. Whether you’re a strategy mastermind or a casual player craving a fresh challenge, Doge Storm delivers an addictive mix of depth, humor, and unpredictability that keeps you hooked from day one.

A Nation on the Brink

In Doge Storm, you inherit a sprawling, chaotic bureaucracy: 15 departments and 240 distinct institutions, each brimming with personality, peril, and potential. From the gritty Workers’ Welfare Commission to the lofty Academy Advancement Council, every entity has its own duties, budgets, staff counts—and a laundry list of crises begging for your intervention. Your mission is to steer this storm-tossed nation through 240 intense days, balancing three pivotal metrics: Support Rate (starting at a shaky 50%), National Debt Ratio (a towering 124%), and Administrative Efficiency Coefficient (a fragile 0.65). Every choice you make sends shockwaves through the system, for better or worse.

Command with Precision—or Chaos

As Tlon, you wield a deceptively simple arsenal: hire, fire, dissolve, or stand pat. Each day, a new institution steps into the spotlight, its NPC delivering a duty report laced with desperation or defiance—often both. Will you trim staff by a cautious 0-20% (C1), swing the axe with an 80-100% cut (C5), dismantle the whole operation (C6), or let it ride unchanged (C7)? The power is yours, but the stakes are high. A small layoff might shore up funds but erode public trust, while dissolving a bloated department could spark a backlash—or a breakthrough. Doge Storm thrives on this tension, offering endless strategic paths with no easy answers.

Unleash the Storm: Dynamic Events

What makes Doge Storm truly electric is its storm of events—over 1200 in total, with five unique scenarios per institution. Every decision you make can ignite 0-2 random events, each delayed by 0-4 days, turning every choice into a gamble with the future. Cut 20% of a library’s staff, and “Books Lost in Chaos” might hit days later, chipping away at efficiency. Dissolve a trade office, and “Export Storm Surge” could crash your debt ratio down the line. Tied to your actions (C1-C7), these events inject unpredictability and replayability, ensuring no two playthroughs feel the same. Can you weather the storm you’ve unleashed?
